name: agent-rule-kit
description: 面向 AI 编程代理的跨工具工程规则与工作流分发系统

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @agentrulekit/core && npm run build --workspace agentrulekit
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && node --test scripts/tests/session-start.test.mjs scripts/tests/cli-e2e.test.mjs scripts/tests/package-install.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @agentrulekit/core && npm run build --workspace @agentrulekit/core && npm run typecheck --workspace agentrulekit
